title: OmniPhysicsBaseMaterialAPI (deformable material friction and density)
summary: Friction and density of an OmniPhysics deformable material. Read on a material the walker enumerates through OmniPhysicsDeformableMaterialAPI or OmniPhysicsSurfaceDeformableMaterialAPI (USD lists this API as their built-in) and on the material bound to a PhysicsScene, in both cases only when OmniPhysicsBaseMaterialAPI is listed in usd-schemas.

columns.name: omniphysics:density
columns.absent: -1.0, the material descriptor's unset sentinel: a bound body without omniphysics:mass gets the default density. The raw fallback 0.0 reads as unset too, so writing it literally is harmless.
columns.sentinel: -1.0; any value <= 0 is treated as unset by the deformable mass computation, which then uses 1000 kg/m^3 (volume) or 100 kg/m^3 (surface) converted to stage units.
columns.notes: Not a PhysX material property; it lives on the runtime's own deformable material record and only feeds the per-vertex masses of bodies bound to this material. Re-read on change, which recomputes those masses.

columns.name: omniphysics:staticFriction
columns.absent: 0.0 (the material descriptor's default). The value is never used: a PhysX deformable material has no static friction.
columns.notes: A change only logs 'Static friction is not supported on deformable bodies'.

columns.name: omniphysics:dynamicFriction
columns.absent: 0.0, frictionless, on a material the walker enumerates. The material bound to the PhysicsScene, which also becomes the scene's default deformable material, starts from the consumer default instead: 0.25.
columns.notes: Re-read on change and applied as the PxDeformableMaterial dynamic friction.

interactions.rule: A material prim becomes a deformable material only through OmniPhysicsDeformableMaterialAPI or OmniPhysicsSurfaceDeformableMaterialAPI. With this API alone only a material bound to a PhysicsScene is read, into the scene's default deformable materials.
